squares.notes: coast.returnAllowed off: a Coast piece that has left the Coast may not come back.
coast.2p.exit = a5-only: a Coast piece leaves the Coast only from A5.

source: Unverified seed (S10, 19 Oct 2026): from docs/RULES.md draft v0.2, ledger decisions D25, D28, D29, D30 and S34, and the owner's board images of 18 and 19 Oct 2026.
notes: The closed Coast (no Coast piece moves, and none gives check, until the Tail opens it: coast.2p.initiation) is game state, not piece data (S17, src/game/game.ts). Ways off the Coast (coast.2p.exit) and capture on the Coast (coast.2p.capturable, coast.3p.capturable) are square rules (S22a). Not expressed yet (engine features): the 3-player first emergence through A5 (coast.3p.exit). givesCheck follows the 2-player setting; in 3-player games the game reads dragon.3p.givesCheck and the duel instead (S56, src/game/three.ts, decision 0016).
